messages:
maya: :rotating_light: Incidentbot didn't page on last run, noticed in runbooks/notify-monitoring. Logs show 401 from pagerflow API.
incidentbot: [automated] failed to deliver page to oncall (err=401 unauthorized). retry_count=0
aj: @maya can you paste the log lines? I'm oncall now :phone:
maya: log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T12:04:12Z ERROR delivery/pagerflow POST /v1/pages 401 {"error":"token_expired","detail":"ephemeral_token expired at 2026-03-18T12:03:59Z"}
```
sam: :eyes: looks like ephemeral token rotation didn't run. opsbot last rotation at 11:03 (should be hourly)
opsbot: rotation-run summary: next_token=null, last_success=2026-03-18T11:03:00Z, next_scheduled=2026-03-18T12:03:00Z, status=skipped (reason=upstream-kms-timeout)
carla: Are there customer hits? any missed pages causing support tickets?
maya: Monitoring: page failures rose to ~3.8% between 12:04-12:13, alerting platform saw no customer-facing errors yet. no open tickets.
jamal: Manual mitigation: can someone page the oncall for the affected teams and escalate? I'll open the incident channel manually.
aj: Paging manual now for infra-oncall and api-oncall. posted call link.
maya: Temporary fix: re-run rotation job now? opsbot can you attempt forced rotate
opsbot: running forced rotation... result=fail (kms rpc timeout). Trying fallback: generate short-lived token via admin key.
opsbot: fallback success, new_ephemeral_token minted exp=2026-03-18T12:30:00Z
incidentbot: [automated] queued 4 pages to infra-oncall, api-oncall, platform-oncall (via fallback token)
sam: Confirmed pages received, infra-oncall acknowledged :thumbsup:
maya: TL;DR: root cause is KMS timeouts causing token rotation to skip -> incidentbot pages 401 and suppressed. Immediate mitigations: manual page + fallback token path enabled. Next: add healthcheck + alert on rotation failures, add retry/backoff to rotation job, add synthetic page test after rotation.
aj: I'll spin up a cherrypick to add alerting. Owner: aj. SLO check needed, assign postmortem to maya+sam.
carla: customer comms: none required now, monitor for 1hr and update support if any tickets appear.
jamal: filing quick incident note in retro doc: link https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3921
maya: thanks everyone, leaving follow-ups in the ticket. closing thread once we have 1h of no regressions.
